name: sigil
description: Give Claude full control of Obsidian — 89 tools for vaults, files, notes, search, tags, sync, plugins and more
long_description: Sigil is an MCP server that lets Claude control Obsidian via the Obsidian CLI. 89 tools across 24 domains: daily notes, files & folders, search, tags, tasks, properties, links & graph, templates, outline, vault management, file history, bookmarks, random notes, word count, workspace, aliases, commands, sync, plugins, bases, themes, CSS snippets, tabs, and hotkeys.

tools.name: obsidian_help
tools.description: Show list of all available Obsidian CLI commands

tools.name: daily_append
tools.description: Append content to today's daily note

tools.name: daily_prepend
tools.description: Prepend content to today's daily note

tools.name: daily_path
tools.description: Get the file path of today's daily note without opening it

tools.name: file_prepend
tools.description: Prepend content after frontmatter of a file

tools.name: file_delete
tools.description: Delete a file (moves to trash by default)

tools.name: file_rename
tools.description: Rename a file in place (stays in same folder)

tools.name: search_context
tools.description: Search vault and return matching lines with surrounding context

tools.name: tag_info
tools.description: Get tag info including files that use it

tools.name: property_set
tools.description: Set a property on a file

tools.name: property_remove
tools.description: Remove a property from a file

tools.name: property_read
tools.description: Read a property value from a file

tools.name: links
tools.description: List outgoing links from a file

tools.name: orphans
tools.description: List files with no incoming links

tools.name: deadends
tools.description: List files with no outgoing links (graph dead ends)

tools.name: template_insert
tools.description: Insert a template into the currently active file

tools.name: vault_reload
tools.description: Reload the vault (refreshes file index without restarting)

tools.name: diff
tools.description: List or compare versions from file history

tools.name: history_versions
tools.description: List available local history versions for a file

tools.name: history_list
tools.description: List all files that have local history entries

tools.name: wordcount
tools.description: Count words and characters in a file

tools.name: command_execute
tools.description: Execute an Obsidian command by ID

tools.name: sync_deleted
tools.description: List deleted files in sync history

tools.name: sync_history
tools.description: List sync version history for a file

tools.name: sync_read
tools.description: Read a specific sync version of a file

tools.name: sync_restore
tools.description: Restore a specific sync version of a file

tools.name: plugins_list
tools.description: List all installed plugins (core and community)

tools.name: plugin_info
tools.description: Get info about a specific plugin

tools.name: plugin_install
tools.description: Install a community plugin by ID

tools.name: plugin_reload
tools.description: Reload a plugin (useful for applying updates without restarting)

tools.name: plugins_restrict
tools.description: Toggle restricted mode (disables all community plugins when on)

tools.name: bases_list
tools.description: List all base files in the vault (Obsidian Bases feature)

tools.name: base_views
tools.description: List views in a base file

tools.name: base_query
tools.description: Query a base and return results

tools.name: base_create
tools.description: Create a new item in a base

tools.name: theme_info
tools.description: Show active theme or get info about a specific theme

tools.name: tab_open
tools.description: Open a new tab, optionally with a file or view

tools.name: hotkey_info
tools.description: Get the hotkey assigned to a specific command
